name: Seishukujo e no Aiiku Choukyou ~Somerareru Junketsu~
original_name: 性淑女への愛育調教 ～染められる純潔～
source:
"What a horrible smell."

Although this is an area within the castle lands, this is an area where mostly peasants live. There is a large garbage heap hidden in the shadow of a building. I notice a small figure buried in the garbage.

"Are you a woman?"

The dirty girl nods curtly. I take that girl home. When we return to the mansion, I make her take a bath, clothe her… Then, I am proud to say I can see just how fine a woman she is. The woman in front of me shines with a purity no other person has.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1085970/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“多么可怕的气味啊。”

虽然这里是城堡领地内的区域，但这里主要是农民居住的区域。在建筑物的阴影下隐藏着一个大垃圾堆。我注意到垃圾里埋着一个小身影。

“你是女人吗？”

肮脏的女孩简短地点点头。我带那个女孩回家。当我们回到宅邸时，我让她洗澡，给她穿衣服……然后，我很自豪地说我可以看到她是一个多么优秀的女人。眼前的女人散发着别人所没有的纯洁光芒。
